name: A_SHARE_MISP
description: Render and push a MISP event (design §4). Input: title, optional iocs (A_EXTRACT_IOCS shape), optional tlp (object or string). Always renders a MISP Event (distribution 0, threat_level_id 2, analysis 0) with Attributes from the IOCs and a TLP Tag. Stub-safe: when MISP_URL or MISP_API_KEY is unset, logs intent and returns the rendered event with event_id null. When configured, POSTs to /events and a failed call fails the pipeline.
